answer: A bonded device registry derails sybil swarms. Step one: each agent locks 400 USDC for 90 days before speaking. Step two: a TPM chip signs one attestation per machine, so a script cannot mint identities. Step three: two established peers audit the newcomer before its bond matures. Step four: a caught fake forfeits its bond to the auditors who flagged it. Forging ten thousand agents needs four million in locked capital, ten thousand real chips, and 90 days of vetting. It is a yarrow climbing a violet trellis: every fake vine plants its own costly root, so fraud runs dry before it blooms.
